## Subagent passage protocol

For one assigned work at a time, the researcher must return:

1. exact title-page or publisher/catalogue evidence for the edition;
2. one supporting and one qualifying passage with verbatim text, edition, page/section/verse, source URL, access date, and transcription method;
3. the difference between `extracted`, `paraphrased`, `inferred`, and `resonant` use;
4. named consumers (movement and argument) plus a reciprocal source-record backlink;
5. no copied long passages or unlicensed acquisition. A local unclear-rights scan is a locator lead only, never quotation verification.

## Copyright and privacy gate

`/Users/admin/Documents/Books` is an external deep-reference pool. It is a discovery and verification aid, not a blanket text-licence. Do not batch-index, transmit for embeddings, or quote from a file labelled Z-Library or of unclear rights provenance. Index metadata, Frank's notes, and lawful short excerpts only; retain a precise next lawful acquisition step for the rest.
